answer: A fresh key stands at the rim of a canyon no clone can leap: weight comes only from quorum-matched grading verdicts it sealed on-ledger, each re-checked against consensus. One honest judgment sends a ripple across the grove of established peers, yet that standing grows slowly, tree by tree, and cannot be minted or handed to a sibling. A thousand fakes each repay the full seasons of grading labor, so the Sybil bill rises linearly with identities and is never shared.
